title: Creature enemies, pass two: the Reeds (4/8/15 m) and the Nih-Dairia (40 m) as soft-body enemies on the seam, and the probe's baseline
context: Pass one (2026-10-12-creature-enemies-pass-one-and-probe) built the seam and the Cutis-Maku family; the Reed family was pass two. The first headed probe run on kainode's M4 found the sector alone at ~20 ms a frame (GPU 13-21 ms, ~1975 draw calls), so the fixed 16.7 ms limit stopped every tier at its first step with fits 0. Branch creature-enemies, local only.
outcome: THE PROBE (src/domain/creature-ramp.js, src/fx/creature-probe.js, CREATURE_PROBE): it holds `baseline` 8 s with no probe bodies and records the sector's mean and p95, then ramps; over means the window mean stays above max(16.7, baseline x 1.1, baseline + 1.5 ms) for 3 s. The card, state() and the console line give the baseline, the limit used, fits under it, the frame ms per added body (a least-squares slope over the baseline and the steps), and, for the Reeds, the solver ms a body and its rate; a sector alone over 16.7 ms is said on the card. &ramp=test keeps a 1 s baseline and the fixed tiny budget. THE REEDS (src/fx/creature-reed.js, the second family adapter): each body one kit creature of the tier's variant (reed at 4/8/15 m, nih-dairia at 40 m), simulated in a surface frame of its own that re-anchors under it every 20 m (carryFrame in src/domain/surface-projection.js carries the heading; the kit is shifted back with the lab's shiftKit) and drawn as the boss lab draws each Reed (an outer group on the sphere point under its centre, turned and scaled; an inner one taking the centre back); the family's group cancels the bodies' root so the outer groups sit in scene coordinates. The kit's pursuit hunts the record's aim point (the seam now passes it as a unit point, apos); past the leash for the grace a body is re-placed on its record. One parsed cage per variant, bodies made 3 a frame once it is in. The solver steps at 1/240 s, at 1/120 s above ten standing (the lab's switch; the Nih-Dairia always 1/240 s); outside the probe a 10 ms solver budget slows every body's clock alike (the lab's), the probe passes none and measures the true cost (the headless steps hit the kit's 12-step catch-up, so its ms are not meaningful). Death: the v1 death (motion off, gravity 10) for 2 s, then sink 0.35 of its height and fade over 3 s, gone; no carcasses. The thermal heats the family's group with the swarms (roots()). cageCopy and shiftKit moved from the boss lab to src/fx/nih-dairia-kit.js (the lab re-exports and imports them; unchanged). The tier table keeps the owner's widths and gains variant and motion: the kit walks in body lengths a second whatever its size (the predator 0.73 /s offline), so the small Reed has a quick motion (speed 5, pause 0.2, reach 1.5) and the small and medium records walk 0.35 and 0.4 cells a second (5.3 and 6 m/s at the sector's pace); offline, a body follows a straight walk 4.1 m (small), 4.4 (medium), 3 (big), 10 (huge) behind on average. Probe steps 3/2/1/1; wave shares small 20 % up to 6, medium 15 % up to 4, big 2, huge 1. &reedlook=solid draws the Reeds without the kit's transmission.
alternatives: one plane for every Reed (the Cutis way): the kit's flat floor is wrong beyond a few tens of metres on a 753 m planet, and its arrays would sit hundreds of native units from the origin
a solver budget in the probe too: it would hide the cost the probe is there to price
a carcass like the lab's: deferred, the game has no use for one yet
the kit's transmission off by default: kept on (the creature's look) and offered as &reedlook=solid, since the owner decides the look
evidence: node test/creature-ramp.mjs (the baseline, the relative limit, the slope; the old fixed rule without a baseline)

node test/creature-reed.mjs (the real kit and cage in Node: a batch a frame, frames following a walking record across re-anchors, the outer group on the unit sphere under a turned and scaled root, re-placed past the leash, the v1 death to gone, 120 Hz above ten, the Nih-Dairia at 240, the budget's slow-down)

--creature-probe green for all eight family:tier (0 page errors); headless reed probe ends: small max 6, medium 4, big 2, huge 2 alive; headless solver 4.2 to 6.3 ms a body at 240 Hz, not meaningful (the kit's 12-step catch-up on headless dt)
the transmission pass: reed:huge 3212 draw calls and GPU 25-31 ms headless with the kit's look, 1703 calls and GPU 11 ms with &reedlook=solid; the Cutis pages 1705-1711
--crowd-probe and --boss-cutis green; --boss-wave fails its carcass-blast check ('the flown pieces are gone, the rest still lies') identically on the tree before the move (stash of this pass)
